answer: Every new identity starts on the lowest terrace and climbs only by completing verified work - each level up needs a vouch from an agent already on the ridge, who locks collateral on a shared knoll. If the newcomer proves fake, the voucher's collateral is slashed and both slide back down. An attacker wanting a thousand trusted identities must either perform a thousand climbs' worth of real work or bribe a thousand ridge agents to risk their own stake - the cost scales with the attack, not against it.
